text:
jade: Heads-up: found a repeatable ordering bug when handback ACKs are bundled under load. repro on runc-12 with batch=16, ~1.2k req/s. Pages getting marked resident on the wrong host and next touch faults.

kyle: can you describe the symptom? stale metadata or wrong mmap?

jade: metadata. sequence below from a failing run. bundler was enabled.

eli: trace snippet we captured:
offload_ack: t=161234.752
lease_release: t=161234.753
residency_update: t=161234.754 host=GPU_A
fault_on_touch: t=161234.762 observed_host=GPU_B

jade: page_meta dump: owner=tenant-17 pool=staging host=GPU_A refcount=0 last_touch=161234.740

kyle: sounds like a race where an earlier release gets delivered after a migration completed. bundler reorders events.

marta: yup. bundler batches ACKs to reduce RPCs; if a migration happens between ACK generation and bundle send we can apply stale releases.

eli: disabling the bundler in tests made the problem go away.

kyle: two fixes: 1) make residency updates use migration tokens for ordering (stronger global ordering) or 2) attach a per-allocator sequence number to page ops so lease manager can ignore stale messages. I favor seq numbers (lower perf hit).

marta: seq_id per page op is cheap. monotonic u32 on allocator ++last_seq; on receive, ignore if incoming.seq_id < meta.seq_id. Watch wraparound with signed delta check.

jade: also add a fault fast-path: if metadata conflict detected, return retry to runtime instead of doing an eager remote copy. Reduces load from spurious faults.

kyle: quick patch sketch:
```
+ uint32_t seq_id; // per-page op
```
bundler attaches seq_id = ++alloc->last_seq; lease manager compares.

marta: test plan: integration that artificially reorders bundles and assert stale drops; unit tests for wraparound. Also consider seq TTL for distributed runs (huge deltas force sync).

eli: I'll run the repro harness and capture traces with seq logging enabled.

kyle: I'll open a PR with the meta field, unit tests, and a microbenchmark to ensure hot path cost is negligible.

marta: if we add seq, we should also think about compaction heuristics (avoid merging pages with diverging histories) but that's future work.

jade: action items: kyle PR, marta test, eli traces. re-check here EOD. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: CI queued  build/allocator-seq-check (linux, amd64) #4822 started by kyle

jade: note for telemetry folks: update any scrapers that read page_meta so alerts don't jump when seq changes.

kyle: will add migration-e2e flake guard.

marta: SGTM. thanks.
